_comment: Item 7: pinned source manifest for the transportability layer — full provenance/audit.

trial_data.use: arm-level % weight change, baseline conditions (diabetes status), survival HRs

target_distribution_primary.subset: adults age>=18, BMI>=30 (obese); n=3688; survey-weighted WTMECPRP
target_distribution_primary.note: REPLACES the earlier hardcoded 26% (web-derived, too high). Joint distribution + ethnicity (RIDRETH3) available.

IDF_Diabetes_Atlas_2021.caveat: general-adult; obese-subset is higher -> scaled by obese/general ratio for the atlas

obese_general_ratio.validation: IDF N.America 15.0% x1.8 = 27% ~ NHANES US-obese (microdata 20.6%, web-26%) — order-consistent
obese_general_ratio.use: scales IDF general-adult regional prevalence to an obese-subset target where no direct survey exists

modifier.name: diabetes status (binary)
modifier.validity: pure strata (obesity-only/T2D-only trials) -> study-level = individual-level -> NOT ecological
modifier.second_modifier_BMI: near-target (trial 35.8 vs 36.4 microdata) -> ~0 transport contribution (ecological, flagged)
